# apple_in_app_purchase (Resource)

Manages an in-app purchase: a consumable, non-consumable or non-renewing subscription. Set its customer-facing names with `apple_in_app_purchase_localization`, and submit it with `apple_submit_in_app_purchase`. Product IDs can't be reused, even after deletion. Destroying the resource deletes a purchase that was never approved; an approved one stays, and can be removed from sale in App Store Connect. Import it with `<app_id>/<id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_in_app_purchase" "coins" {
  app_id      = data.apple_app.example.id
  product_id  = "com.example.coins100"
  type        = "CONSUMABLE"
  name        = "100 Coins"
  review_note = "Open Store, then tap 100 Coins."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `name` (String) Reference name, seen only in App Store Connect; up to 64 characters.
- `product_id` (String) Product ID the app uses in StoreKit, e.g. `com.example.coins100`. It can't be reused.
- `type` (String) Type: `CONSUMABLE`, `NON_CONSUMABLE`, `NON_RENEWING_SUBSCRIPTION`.

### Optional

- `family_sharable` (Boolean) Whether family members can use the purchase, for non-consumables and non-renewing subscriptions. Once on, it can't be turned off. Defaults to `false`.
- `review_note` (String) Notes for App Review, up to 4,000 characters.

### Read-Only

- `content_hosting` (Boolean) Whether Apple hosts content for the purchase.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the in-app purchase.
- `state` (String) State of the purchase, e.g. `MISSING_METADATA`, `READY_TO_SUBMIT` or `APPROVED`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_in_app_purchase.coins
  identity = {
    app_id = "1234567890"
    id     = "6446452615"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the in-app purchase.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_in_app_purchase.coins 1234567890/6446452615
```
